# Target
Review snapshot-recovery specification candidate snapshot-recovery-spec-r16@r16 in specification mode. No implementation exists. The bound r15 CodeReviewer review was APPROVE with 5 LOW (cr-r15-raw.md); the bound r15 Critic review was REVISE on C6 (ct-r15-raw.md). Verify this r16 revision closes them.

# Required checks
- Verify C6 closure with exact text: R2's moved-symlink target preservation versus R5 retention. Confirm the protection semantics are complete and non-contradictory: which candidate is excluded, how relative-link resolution and same-family pre-existing targets are handled, whether the successful-path bound is still exactly QuarantineKeep, how oldest-first ordering proceeds past the protected candidate, and what AC1-3/AC1-10(b-prot) assert (target bytes preserved, quarantine read-through, explicit survivor counts). Look for a new counterexample that deletes or dangles the backing evidence, or that lets the protected target make the bound exceed five on the success path.
- Verify CR15-01 ticket-mirror account matches the observed ticket (heading r15, body r15, header r7, no sha256) and does not conflict with section 9.7's stated lag.
- Verify CR15-02: T1 is scoped to AC1-1..AC1-5, AC1-7..AC1-10, AC1-6 storage half, AC2-8; T3 owns AC1-6's cmd half; no dual ownership remains on paper and the split matches the files each task may write.
- Verify CR15-03: wiring.go:486-494 and log.go:227-276 citations are correct and consistent everywhere they appear.
- Verify CR15-04: AC2-2 includes the four-field snapshot_unavailable ErrorInfo shape case and T2 pins it; validErrorInfo exact-equality admission makes a wrong remediation fail.
- Verify CR15-05: the new 6-seed/two-excess subcases under AC1-3 and AC1-9 assert two evictions in one pass with total five, and the third unlink is an over-deletion failure.
- Regression: R1-R9, AC1-1..AC1-10, AC2-1..AC2-9, T1-T3 ids unchanged; section 6.1 write set equals the 14-file envelope and the per-task write sets; no new dependency or observable change to Load/Save/LoadPrompts/SavePrompts/ensureReplaceable.
- Confirm the review is against these exact bytes; report any low advisory separately from blocking findings. Do not propose a new id or envelope widening.

# Output contract
Report severity (CRITICAL/HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW), file:line anchor and confidence per finding. End with exactly '### Recommendation' then APPROVE or REQUEST CHANGES.
